title: Bahr
overview: It follows a struggling young man facing the pressures of life and unemployment crises in the city of Port Said. Things take a turn when he falls for a girl who works in the circus, while entering into sharp confrontations and unexpected clashes with his opponents.

title: Traveler's Hell
overview: On an isolated road late at night, a young woman, driving alone, comes across a stranded male driver whose car has broken down on a mountain road notorious for disappearances and murders. Choosing empathy over a creeping sense of foreboding, she offers him a ride to the nearest station. That single choice unleashes a harrowing chain of strange and terrifying events in the dead of night, turning a simple gesture of kindness into a real-life nightmare.

title: Possessed
overview: A group of young people embark on an exploratory adventure to investigate Egypt's most famous locations rumored to be haunted by jinn, aiming to uncover the truth behind the legends surrounding them. As their journey unfolds, they encounter a series of mysterious incidents and inexplicable events that alter the course of their adventure, confronting them with secrets that stir up doubt and fear.
